q: How much lower is the carbon figure for copper rod made from scrap?
title: Copper from scrap: carbon per tonne
short: Usually much lower than primary copper, because mining, concentrating and smelting ore are skipped. What remains is the furnace fuel and electricity to melt and refine the scrap, plus collection and transport. Work it out from your own fuel and power per tonne, and state the recycled share on every buyer figure.
audience: Copper scrap refiners, rod makers and cable makers in India and their buyers

ul: Furnace fuel or electricity for melting and fire refining.
Transport of scrap to the plant.

p: Buyers want the share of recycled input next to the figure. Keep scrap purchase records by grade and tonnes.
Scrap usually enters with no upstream emissions under the common cut off approach. Say which approach you used.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so a copper product figure can be traced back to the documents behind it. Factors outside India are entered from the official source and labelled.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
